title: Knew Bigelow at the Rockefeller ranch

tellings.quote: Bigalow was one of those. But I knew him at the Rockefeller ranch in 93.

plain: Steven Greer, a man who campaigns for the government to release what it knows about UFOs, says he knew a man named Robert Bigelow in 1993. According to Greer, they met at the JY Ranch in Teton County, Wyoming, which belonged to Laurance Rockefeller, a member of the wealthy Rockefeller family. He tells it to show that he was among the private figures interested in the subject early on.
